Voorlezen gebruikt de stem van het toest: Reading aloud uses the voice on the pupil's device. If there is no Flemish voice, the pupil first sees a message and then hears another Dutch voice. If there is no voice at all, LANcelot asks the pupil to raise their hand. The live overview then shows 🗣 or 🔇 next to the name.
Leerlingen kunnen het geluid testen met: Pupils can test the sound with the "Test sound" button in My tasks and before a test.
